LESSON: READING 6.2.1 READING: FLUENCY

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.2: Reading 6.2.1 Reading: Fluency
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 6.2.1 Reading: Fluency, part of Strand 6 in Grade 7 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to read fluently?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. view a variety of video clips featuring well-read scripts related to the theme,

2. watch news clips from a favourite television programme/presenter and comment on the presenter’s speed, accuracy, and expression,

3. brainstorm ways of reading effectively,

4. reflect on the qualities of a good reader,

5. read a text such as a poem, a narrative, or dialogue with: o appropriate expressions o accuracy o right speed,

6. listen to a text read by a peer and provide feedback,

7. engage in a readers’ theatre and read a poem, narrative, or dialogue,

8. read a choral verse in pairs or small groups,

9. time himself or herself while reading an excerpt of a text,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. view a variety of video clips featuring well-read scripts related to the theme,
2. watch news clips from a favourite television programme/presenter and comment on the presenter’s speed, accuracy, and expression,
3. brainstorm ways of reading effectively,
4. reflect on the qualities of a good reader,
5. read a text such as a poem, a narrative, or dialogue with: o appropriate expressions o accuracy o right speed,
6. listen to a text read by a peer and provide feedback,
7. engage in a readers’ theatre and read a poem, narrative, or dialogue,
8. read a choral verse in pairs or small groups,
9. time himself or herself while reading an excerpt of a text,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 6.2.1 Reading: Fluency together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to learn: It is developed as the learner builds on own learning experiences by listening and modelling fluent

reading.

• Self-efficacy: It is developed as the learner documents success criteria while timing themselves as they read excerpts in

pairs.

• Communication and collaboration is enhanced as the learner recites a choral verse clearly.

Values

Respect is achieved as the learner values human dignity while listening to their peers’ reading.
